description.zh: 域名，长度1-50，可以为数字、大写字母、小写字母、.、-。
description.en: Domain name, length 1-50, can include numbers, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, ., and -.

description.zh:
- 长度为10~20位，且必须包含数字、大写字母、小写字母。

- 至少包含2位数字、2位大写字母和2位小写字母，并且数字和字母均不能只由单一字符重复组成。

- 不能与上一次设置密码相同。
description.en:
- Length should be between 10 to 20 characters, and must contain numbers, uppercase letters, and lowercase letters.

- At least 2 digits, 2 uppercase letters, and 2 lowercase letters are required, and neither digits nor letters can consist of a single character repeated.

- Cannot be the same as the last set password.

title.zh: 设置域名的 SMTP 的密码
title.en: Set the SMTP password for a domain

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm modify-pw-by-domain --domain-name example.com --password DM1mail1234 --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
